description: This file defines a parser class for screen recording trace data, including methods for decoding trace data, extracting timestamps, and handling metadata entries. It also includes utility functions for parsing binary data and constants for magic numbers.

classes.name: ScreenRecordingMetadataEntry
classes.description: Represents a metadata entry with elapsed and realtime timestamps.

classes.name: ParserScreenRecording
classes.description: A parser class for screen recording trace data, extending AbstractParser, with methods for decoding trace data, extracting timestamps, and processing entries.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the trace type for this parser, which is SCREEN_RECORDING.

methods.name: getMagicNumber
methods.description: Returns the magic number array identifying the trace data format.

methods.name: decodeTrace
methods.description: Decodes video data to extract metadata entries with timestamps.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns a Timestamp object for a given metadata entry and timestamp type.

methods.name: processDecodedEntry
methods.description: Processes a decoded metadata entry to produce a ScreenRecordingTraceEntry.

methods.name: searchMagicString
methods.description: Searches for the magic string in video data to locate metadata start.

methods.name: parseMetadataVersion
methods.description: Parses the metadata version from video data.

methods.name: parseRealToElapsedTimeOffsetNs
methods.description: Parses the real-to-elapsed time offset from video data.

methods.name: parseFramesCount
methods.description: Parses the number of timestamp frames.
